event_chain.summary: Unauthorized third party exploits a portal vulnerability / admin accounts and downloads user names
Portal taken offline for over a week during response

summary: On October 29, 2026 Ireland's Department of Enterprise, Tourism and Employment said it had identified suspicious unauthorised activity on its Employment Permits Online System portal and a security vulnerability, and took the portal offline. It suspended registrations, restricted administration access, removed access from suspected compromised administrator accounts and engaged independent cybersecurity specialists. A November 5 update said the unauthorised third party had downloaded users' first names and surnames (not email addresses or account roles), with a very small number of accounts under separate investigation. The Data Protection Commission was notified and affected users contacted; the portal stayed offline past its planned November 3 reopening.
